notes.title: Workshop and mod support Update!
notes.content:
Hello Dino Slayers!

This update is rolling out a base for workshop support and foundation for various customizations for Dinosaur Hunt. 

From the in-game menu you can install Uncle Joe AK47 skin:

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1473493840

In this patch you you can also add your own very custom AK47 skin, here is how to do it:

In the folder where the game is installed, next to executable there is a folder called ..._DATA, inside you will another folder called StreamingAssets.

If you copy an image file there and name it: ak47.png 

It will be used as a skin for your AK47 in the game.  

Stay tuned as more updates are coming!

May the shotgun be with you, 

ANPA.US

notes.title: Update #680
notes.content:
Hey All

This update is quite big c.a. 2GB, mainly because of updated graphics features and upgraded core engine, on top of that here is what comes with it:

- multiplayer now counts headshots and kills correctly and attribute them correctly to players

- fixed a bug for player model rotation in multiplayer

- dino achivos can now be obtained also in multiplayer mode

- pausing a game now pauses all clients

- fixed a bug when assigning controls and pressing ESC would cause to unpause the game with controls window still visible

- fixed a bug with flashlight, now it is possible to assign a custom key 

- more graphic options for post processing effects (Sunshafts, Tonemapping, Fog etc.)

- additional slider to adjust FOV

- Weather is now correctly sync in multiplayer mode

- fixed bugs with weapon pickups when player could pickup more weapons than 3 and it was difficult to switch between them, now weapons are correctly assigned to weapon keys (1,2,3)

- possibility to change quality setting directly in game (FAST to BEAUTIFUL)

- adjusted lobby UI, with a dark skin so it is correctly visible on white backgrounds

Enjoy

ANPA.US

notes.title: Update 1042788
notes.content:
This update is focused on performance and "pain" points to make gameplay "smoother":

- another set of performance adjustements to base game and DLCs, this should be significant for lower spec PCs
- specific performance improvements to zombie DLC city maps
- zombie DLC updates to zombie movement 
- new feature to quickly draw weapons, first, second and third one with 1,2,3 keys (configurable under controls)
- you can now holster weapon
- you can now throw object when moving it (this is to prepare a foundation for objects that can be thrown at enemy to hurt them, in example bottle)
- added keys to select next and previous weapon (additionally to switch weapons with mouse scroll), configurable under controls
- minimap adjustements to instead render area in detail, minimap now is covering much wider range and focus on indicating enemy position
- fixed some shadow bugs
- ammo pickup fix, you will now only pickup ammo if you are not full and it will only count to currently selected weapon
- added two trailers with gameplay to store page

That's it for now. It is time to pave your way with blood. Dinosaur blood.

notes.title: Updates Summary
notes.content:
It was a busy week, here is the summary of what was updated and fixed:

- Achievements added
- Leaderboard added
- Trading Cards added 
- Dinosaur Headshots - you can now headshot dinos 
- Campaign mode - automatically goes through all the maps, it gives around 200 missions 
- Tracker option - you can now enable/disable dinosaur location pointer 
- Health regeneration - you can now enable/disable health regeneration 
- Slow Motion/Bullet Trace/Bullet Follow - you can now enable/disable slow motion effects on sniper rifle 
- Bullets and weapons load after one click (removed the tick confirming load as it was misleading) 
- inverted mouse option 
- 6 music themes with disable option 
- dinos will now slow down when got hit
- tweaks to dins behaviour, each dino has now different damage and hp, so in example raptors are fast and can kill you with one bite, but are easy to kill. On the opposite side, Triceratops or Brontosaurus is slower, has lower damage, but is harder to kill. 
- New maps
- Removed killing limits on maps and survival mode 
- sniper and crossbow upgrades moved to armory tab 
- Tab upgrades renamed to MODES and Three gameplay modes available: 

1:1 Hunt - Hunting one specific target, some side actors can exist counted as "extra kill", to complete mission need to kill target, automatically loads next mission 

1:ALL Hunt - All targets activated at once, will not attack until shoot/approached 

1:ALL Survival - now you can activate survival mode from the store 

You can still activate EXPLORER mode, where you can explore the map when the target is eliminated. 


Bug Fixes 
- sniper rifle fixed transparency issue 
- machine gun fixed texture resolution 
- Uzi renamed to MP5 
- remapped keys, mouse cursor fix, ESC key to go back and exit, dinos attack after one hit and other minor fixes) 
- adjusted speed of dins and spawning points in survival mode 
performance improvement on MOB map 
- Village colliders fixed on ROCKIES map 
- minor bugfixes and weapon prices adjustment 
- APO map waves now spawn at least 4 zombies 
- MOB map waves now spawn 5 enemies 
- Cursor locked inside the view while playing on map 
- APO map fixed 
- Minor fixes 

Thanks for playing and Have Fun.
